name: Second-brain research loop
description: Turn an open question into a durable research brief and explicit follow-up tasks.

nodes.label: Frame question
nodes.description: Restate the question, identify the decision it supports, and define what a useful answer must contain.

artifact.description: Question framing notes: decision, scope, constraints, and success criteria.

nodes.label: Gather sources
nodes.description: Collect a small set of high-signal sources and record why each source is credible or limited.

artifact.description: Source list with claims, links or locators, and quality notes.

nodes.label: Write brief
nodes.description: Synthesize findings, tradeoffs, recommendation, and follow-up questions into a durable artifact.

artifact.description: Final research brief suitable for future recall.

nodes.label: Validate taxonomy
nodes.description: Inspect the research-brief artifact metadata and confirm it includes at least one valid PARA bucket tag in the form para:<bucket>/<slug> before finalization.

artifact.description: Validation note naming the artifact id and the PARA tag that places it in the user's second-brain system.

nodes.label: Finalize brief
nodes.description: Finalize the research-brief artifact after taxonomy validation passes so it becomes durable output for this research pass.

artifact.description: Reference to the finalized research-brief artifact.

nodes.label: Decide next actions
nodes.description: Mark the task done if the brief supports the decision, or add specific follow-up tasks for remaining blockers.

artifact.description: Task updates or follow-up questions derived from the brief.
